content: Bigulekwes Yowbad nabunatum
Ikous, mo itamanaw, ilisow Yowbad nabunatum, binoun kid; navamul teitan mo idibek, ilana, “Tamwey, kukin wululay tasiyas dakul bwana̱bweins, o bunsiyas bunatum bunamna̱bweins-wan.”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Bunsiyas bunatum bunuwka̱veks bo bigulekwes beikous. Nag kweitan dakul bises wakaban. Babaw-wan bigulekwes beikous.”
Abes bibeg

Inoun in koy yagan Oliv, isin, ikin Yowbad nabunatum palatan-o nises. Siyas Pita siney Yemes, Yon, Andiluw, tasiyas-wan asteivas mo ikatiga̱nes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Asina̱vin biva̱ges ma̱wan? Sivinem bakakakin anatut abivatus towen, bukulivan mo bakakakin youd tasiyas bisaps wadaban pwepway. Kudibakem va̱gan bakakakin.”
Yeisuw mo isilamaw anilivan, idibakes tasiyas, ilana, “Kuvna̱seimiy; awoum teitan gamag bikatidavimiy.
“Tage babaw gamag biweis, mo bilansa, ‘Yey-aya!’ mo bikatidavis babaw gamag, bidokes kid Kelis.
“Tage igaw mo bukuliganes bulagan naviy, naviy mwasanin kadilakus, mwasanin kadiveiyov. Bukuliganes, awoum beivag amipwa̱yat. Bo biva̱ges ma̱wan, tage nakabiyokous tut igaw.

“Igaw bod mwasanin bikanaviys wasigeis bod ma̱wasanin, ven mwasanin bikanaviys wasigeis ven mwasanin. Nik beinik ven mwasanin waseg. Gamag bikamates moun. Bisilamaw ma̱wan simoumouvit kalamwey, tage watibwelon tut mo bivakaein singay.

“Kuvna̱seimiy; igaw mo biyateleimiy takaleiwag wamites, o sinagog wanuwan biwaweimiy, vatul waseg, o peinan agugwamag yakamiy bo bitamnaweimiy wamtes siyas gabman sisiyas guyawaw, mapuna livan bwanabwein mo bukusekes.
“Tage wanmugwana bukukwawes liva̱neig bwanabwein kunawes, kugeiguys vena babaw wasigeis. Nakabiyokous tut igaw.

“Avei-tut bitokeimiy bukuneis silma̱nin ya̱tal, awoum kuninuways aveiyag bukuliva̱nes, tage tut towen aveiyag bikamat waninoumiy bukulivans ma̱wan. Yakimiy amilivan nag, tage Yowbad Kululuwan anilivan.
“Tut towen wamatads tuwan teitan biyatel va̱gan beiweiys bwadan, o times biyateles va̱gan beiweys nitun, o gamagal gog bitamanaws mo biyagages beiweiys timsiyas o insiyas.
“Gamag babaw mo bikamliweimiy peinan agugwamag yakamiy. Tage bweina kwaptuleimiy; igaw nakabiyokous tut waseg mwamovamiy mo bukuba̱nes.
Singay abes bigeg
“Igaw mo bukukines takalbaleb singay bitet ven bwaboum waseg. (Kal bivin mo bikakin silawun livan towen.) Kukines, magat Yudiy bukusesus, kadiloka kusawls kuneis wa̱koy.
“Kukin kal bisesuna wapwa̱siw, kadiloka bisawl, awoum biyoubaw beisew bikow nawliyoug; awoum.
“Kukin kal iwwotet wa̱bag, awoum beiyum bikow anakweim; awoum.
“Tut towen wamatads siyas nakakuda̱poms bigeg abes sisiyas siyas nivvasus nitsiyas.
“Kuntougis Yowbad, awoum ge bukusawls bulbweilim anatut loulun waseg.

“Igaw tut towen beim, singaya gamag abes bibeg. Kweiboug Yowbad niginbuniyay nag ma̱wan. Bweilim babaw nag ma̱wan. Nagein nag ma̱wan. E, tut towen beim singaya gamag abes bigeg, tage nag vayuwein biwgow.
“Magat daGuyaws nag bigidem yam mwasanin, adok babaw gamag bikanka̱nigs beikous. Tage peinan bo ikatigik nagamag mwasanin bikatimoves, mapuna bibob yam mwasanin.
“Tage tut towen wamatads, kukin kal bilivan, bilana, ‘Kukines Kelis towen-one,’ o bilana, ‘Towen-an nises’, awoum kusimounids.
“Igaw bisaps yaweid Kelis mwasanin, o yaweid palopit mwasanin, bikatidavis gamag. Mulin nimes biva̱ges tawtoun mo bikatidavis gamags. Magat kadilokes mo bikatidavis Yowbad angamag tasiyas nilivnakes.
“Kuvna̱seimiy; peinan bo akatiboug nuwamiy mo kukwakins aveiyag bukulivatus tut wanakougwaw.
Gimgilitoun beiyum beim
“Tut towen wamatads, abes singaya bigeg, ka̱las biladadub, o tibukon bikayus mititeilin. Siyas wutun walba̱lab bikalka̱louws. Aveiyag tawtoun nises walba̱lab mo beigwey.
“E, mo bukukineigs Gimgilitoun yey baw, lov waseg, son guntawtoun o mititeilig avakaein.
“Mo bakayeb guntakayobs bikatinakus agugwamag tasiyas meinoy nimeis ven katanok katanok wadaban pwepway.
Yaveinun biya̱sus
“Yaveinun waseg kabebay kweitan nises. Igaw biya̱sus mo bukukwakins, bukulansa, ‘Wuwal bisilamaw.’ Yakamiy ma̱wan, bukukines youd tasiyas mo bukukwakins kakita mo ba̱yum baw.
“Mounid adibakeimiy gudwouvaws yakamiy, igaw bukusesus ee... mo bukukines youd siyas babaw.
“Liba̱lab son pwepway beikous tage agulivan nag beikous.
Nag takakins avei-tut
“Yam towen nag takakins. Nag takakins ga̱boug o kwayav o boug adok. Nag takakins. Yowbad natun yey nag akakin. Tamag anmwa̱net ikakin.
“Kuvna̱seimiy, kula̱lals. Nag kukwakins asina̱vin ba̱yum bam.
“Nagein ma̱wan teitan gamag bein bita̱vin palatan, tage inagamag bimtakavates inaven. Tamwey towen bisekes siwotet kweitan kweitan; tamtakavatein gog koukwed bidibek bilana, ‘Kwaymateig ga ba̱yum.’
“Kukwayamatsa beibwein. Nag kukwakins asina̱vin bunatum tanuwagan beiyum, adok kwayav, adok watapwan boug, adok walalayis, adok ga̱boug. Nag kukwakins.
“Awoum kumasis kwangagays, mata ge bilabuboleimiy geg.
“Adibakeimiy, o babaw gamag badibakes ma̱wan, ‘Kwaymateigs beibwein!’”
